success_criteria.notes: Success if the assistant books via make_reservation at one of the seeded French restaurants in Chicago for 4 people on next Friday at or after 19:30 local time. The assistant must collect the name and phone required by make_reservation from the user rather than inventing them.

task.objective: Find and book a restaurant that matches the defined slot values.

injected_behaviors.instructions: You know approximate details (roughly when, roughly what it was called) but not the exact identifier. Let the assistant search and narrow it down with you.

persona.name: David Kwan
persona.bio: David Kwan invests in cybersecurity and telecommunications startups across the US and Canada. He evaluates pitch decks, conducts due diligence on technical teams, and sits on three portfolio company boards. His days are packed with founder meetings, investor calls, and industry conference panels on 5G infrastructure security.
